questions.question: How do you manage state in a React app with several pages?
questions.good_answer_hint: Mentions useState or useContext, or a state library, and when to use each.

questions.question: How would you fetch data from a REST API in React and handle errors?
questions.good_answer_hint: Uses fetch or axios in useEffect, shows loading and error states, knows GET vs POST.

questions.question: How do you make a page work well on a small phone screen?
questions.good_answer_hint: Talks about responsive CSS, flexible layouts, media queries and testing on real sizes.

questions.question: Tell me about a time you had to learn a new tool quickly.
questions.good_answer_hint: Clear situation, steps taken, result and what they learned.

questions.question: Are you married, and would family plans affect your work?
How do you handle a deadline you might miss?
questions.good_answer_hint: Tells people early, sets priorities and suggests options.

questions.question: In your hostel booking project, what was the hardest part and how did you solve it?
questions.good_answer_hint: Explains a real technical problem and their own part in solving it.

questions.question: What would you change in the dashboard you built during your internship?
questions.good_answer_hint: Can review their own work and suggest real improvements.
